name: CodeBuddy / WorkBuddy
summary: 腾讯的编程 agent（CodeBuddy Code 命令行、WorkBuddy 桌面版）：查看会话、状态和完整对话；命令行在 tmux 中运行时可回复、确认、回答提问和中断
summaryEn: Tencent's coding agent (CodeBuddy Code CLI and the WorkBuddy desktop app): view sessions, status and full conversations; reply, confirm, answer questions and interrupt when the CLI runs in tmux

cli.note: 回复和确认需要 CodeBuddy Code 在 tmux 中运行

desktop.note: WorkBuddy 桌面版的会话只能查看

cli.note: 从手机操作暂未开放（Windows 上还没实测），只能查看

desktop.note: WorkBuddy 桌面版的会话只能查看

cli.note: 回复和确认需要 CodeBuddy Code 在 tmux 中运行

limitsNote: CodeBuddy / WorkBuddy 按积分计费，积分用量只能在网页的「用量」页查看，本机不记录、也没有查询接口，「今日用量」中不显示；token 按本机记录统计
limitsNoteEn: CodeBuddy / WorkBuddy bill in credits, which you can only check on the Usage page of their website; nothing is recorded on your computer and there's no query interface, so they aren't shown under Today's usage. Tokens are counted from local records
speaker: CodeBuddy
notes: 改进 Windows 上找会话的办法；从手机操作 Windows 上的会话在实测通过前暂不开放，设置 → 插件中有说明。
notesEn: Better session detection on Windows; controlling Windows sessions from your phone stays off until tested, as noted in Settings → Plugins.

gaps.text: Windows 上从手机回复、确认、中断还没实测，暂未开放，只能查看（Kiteline 已能往 Windows 终端里发按键，逐家实测后开放）
gaps.textEn: Replying, confirming and interrupting from your phone on Windows aren't tested yet, so they're off and sessions are view-only (Kiteline can now type into Windows terminals; each agent is enabled once tested)

gaps.text: WorkBuddy 桌面版只能查看：它没有对外的操作接口
gaps.textEn: The WorkBuddy desktop app is view-only: it offers no external control interface

gaps.text: Mac 上还没实测（Linux 上已全部实测）
gaps.textEn: Not yet tested on Mac (fully tested on Linux)

gaps.text: WorkBuddy 桌面版还没在 Mac、Windows 真机上实测（它没有 Linux 版）
gaps.textEn: The WorkBuddy desktop app hasn't been tested on a real Mac or Windows computer yet (it has no Linux version)
